$schema.description: Path to the deployment settings schema.

runtime_markdown.description: Render Markdown in the browser instead of pre-rendering it during the build.

format_source.description: Write formatting changes back to the source files.

format_exclude.description: Site-relative globs excluded from source formatting and CSS/JS minification.

compress_images.description: Use FFmpeg to compress oversized images in dist/.

workers.description: Maximum number of images to compress or watermark concurrently.

image_max_size.description: Per-image compression cap. A bare number is measured in bytes. The limit must be at least one byte.

watermark.description: Optional path to a PNG watermark. Relative paths are resolved from the repository root.

watermark_include.description: Site-relative glob patterns that select images to watermark in dist/.

watermark_opacity.description: Opacity multiplier for the watermark, from transparent (0) to the original opacity (1).
